integration_issues.issue: The reset confirmation dialog (Alert.alert() from React Native) is a browser-native confirm() dialog on web. Playwright cannot detect it via standard DOM selectors. Functionally it works (title is preserved when cancelled), but automated testing of this specific dialog is limited. Not a real UX bug.

issues: Default domain 'dom_sport' (Sport & Outdoor) is at the end of the horizontal scroll list and not visible in the initial viewport (390px width). Already noted in iteration_6. Minor UX improvement: scroll to show selected domain on first render or reorder domains.

reset_dialog_playwright.issue: Alert.alert() reset dialog cannot be detected by Playwright DOM queries
reset_dialog_playwright.root_cause: React Native Web renders Alert.alert() as a browser-native window.confirm() dialog (or custom modal). Playwright cannot detect window.confirm() dialogs via standard DOM selectors. The dialog does function correctly - title is preserved when 'Annuler' is chosen.
reset_dialog_playwright.mitigation: To test reset dialog: use page.on('dialog', ...) Playwright dialog handler before clicking reset-btn, or replace Alert.alert() with a custom React Native Modal component that Playwright can detect via DOM.
